title: Lotaniq Modpack
description: This modpack has some quality of life mods, as well as the end remastered mods, some YUNG's better mods, and the region unexplored mod.
body: This modpack has some quality of life mods, as well as the end remastered mods, some YUNG's better mods, and the region unexplored mod. It also has some texturepacks and the complementary shaders - unbound shaderpack. We have added the bundle recipe as well because it didn't existed in 1.21.1 but we wanted it to exist.
